Fishing guide

Turn on Fishing in the layers: ≈ pool spots per zone (zoom in for every spot), S hot spots from Forever guides, T/$ trainers and suppliers, ! Nat Pagle, Riggle Bassbait, Fishbot 5000, Jang.
Skill 1→300 (where and when)
1–75: any starting-zone water with Shiny Bauble (+25); Zephras Isle counts. Journeyman at 50 and level 10 from any trainer. 75–150: capitals and level 10–20 coasts (nothing gets away in capitals from 75). Expert (125–225): book Expert Fishing – The Bass and You from Old Man Heming in Booty Bay, level 20. 150–225: Dustwallow Marsh with Bright Baubles is the usual pick. Artisan (225–300): quest Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme from Nat Pagle at Tidefury Cove (Dustwallow), level 35; he asks for Feralas Ahi, Misty Reed Mahi Mahi, Sar'theris Striker and Savage Coast Blue Sailfin. Sources: 1mw.io/en/professions/fishing, muchamielwow.github.io.
Valuable catches (Forever)
Oily Blackmouth → Blackmouth Oil (Free Action, Swim Speed, Water Breathing, Enchant Gloves – Fishing): Westfall 41%, Silverpine 36%, Wetlands 24%. Firefin Snapper → Fire Oil (2 per craft in Forever; Elixir of Fire Power, Fire Protection, a dozen tailoring patterns): STV 18%, Wetlands 17%, Desolace 15%, Tanaris 14%. Both bite without schools at the Booty Bay docks (checked in Forever). Stonescale Eel → Stonescale Oil (2 per craft; 10 per Flask of the Titans, Greater Stoneshield, Elixir of Greater Defense): Tanaris 14%, Azshara 12%. Spotted Yellowtail (Cooking 225+, Specklefin Feast), Sunscale Salmon / Nightfin Snapper (+40 AP / +22 spell dmg food), Summer Bass / Winter Squid (Tanaris, by season; 1% crit food), Darkclaw Lobster (Lobster Stew, Grand Lobster Banquet), Mightfish / Whitescale Salmon (lv 45+ food), Raw Greater Sagefish sells to vendors for 1s 25c each (no AH deposit). Fished-up recipes: Swiftness Potion, Limited Invulnerability Potion. Shares are Classic zone-wide numbers. No prices: AH prices differ per realm. Source: wowcamp.fun/en/guides/fishing.
Times & events
Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza: Sundays 2–4 PM server time; first to bring Riggle Bassbait 40 Speckled Tastyfish wins (Arcanite Fishing Pole). 54 school spots, up to 26 at once; skill 225 so none get away; ~12 Bright Baubles; hearth in Booty Bay. Rare fish from the schools (about 1 in 500 casts): Keefer's Angelfish → Lucky Fishing Hat, Brownell's Blue Striped Racer → Nat Pagle's Extreme Anglin' Boots, Dezian Queenfish → High Test Eternium Fishing Line (trade at Fishbot 5000). Jang in Booty Bay trades the winner's coin for new Forever prizes (Surfer Shoes, Master Angler's Fishing Hat, Empty Fish Bucket, Bitter Baitling, Hook of the Master Angler). Night fish (Nightfin) bite on the server's night; seasonal fish follow the calendar. Source: halsudsworth.com/guide/extravaganza/, /events/.
New in Forever
Camp items by the campfire (1 h, shared cooldown): Fish Bowl (Fishing 20, from trainers / Camping 101: Fishing; +8% stats nearby), Fishing Rack (140; uncommon fish for an hour; blueprint from Gelihast in Blackfathom Deeps), Fishing Hut (300; rare fish for an hour; blueprint source unknown). Legacy talent Luremaster: 25/50% chance of an extra fish with a lure. New fish Whimsyfin (School of Whimsyfin, Redridge). Bloated fish are now green and bind on pickup. Six suppliers now sell raw fish. Source: halsudsworth.com/guide/whats-new/.
From the reel: 2 h on the Tanaris coast
@picon_tv (WoW Forever) fished Floating Wreckage along the Tanaris coast for 2 hours: 23 Mithril Bound Trunks → 7 green items, 24 Bolts of Mageweave, 11 Bolts of Runecloth, 12 Greater Mana Potions, coins and a Star Ruby; their total ≈ 20g 55s at their realm's AH prices (their numbers, not measured here). The S pin in Tanaris marks the safe Steamwheedle Port pier.

Gold farming guide

How to start, per the guides below: take a gathering skill early and sell raw materials to players just behind you; most real money arrives in your 30s (warcraftmaps.com/gold). Around 20, wool is what tailors and trading-company crates want (20 per crate), and Forever sped up respawns in those zones (wowcamp.fun). Barrens rares' Blessing of Kalimdor pieces bind on pickup, so they are not a gold farm (wowcamp.fun). For 30–45, conquestcapped.com lists value per kill at EU prices: Hinterlands owlbeasts ~18s (Giant Egg), Arathi Thundering Exiles ~13s (charms, Elemental Air), Tanaris rocs ~12s. Auction prices differ per realm, and nobody has measured gold per hour in Forever yet, so no gold/hour is shown. Only legitimate play: no bots, exploits or gold sellers.

Travel: boat, zeppelin and skycutter docks and routes from the Forever client TaxiPathNode transport paths (stop points), Deeprun Tram entrances from the client AreaTrigger table, who-can-ride from wowseer.gg and hearthproof.com; the Skyborne portal position is a guide's approximate coordinate. Zone levels: wowhandbook.com. Quests: Wowhead's Forever database (level, faction, class, rewards, Forever changes); start/turn-in positions and chain order: QuestieDB Forever data via wow4ever.quest, plus Wowhead Forever quest maps. Hunter pets: spawn points from Wowhead's WoW Forever NPC pages where available, else wowforevertools.com map pins, 1mw.io spawn coordinates or wowfdb.com approximate coordinates (named in each popup); family, speed and abilities from Wowhead/wowfdb.com. Fishing: pool spot positions are Classic 1.12 spawn data from the VMaNGOS world database (Classic carryover, Forever may differ); zone skill, catch shares, fishing NPCs and Forever changes from halsudsworth.com; hot spots and valuable catches from wowcamp.fun and a picon_tv reel (Tanaris coast).
